text:
Maya: Heads up — seeing a cluster of preempt evictions in ap-southeast1. Not huge but pulses every ~2m. CPU/GPU evict count rising. :eyes:
Arjun: Any correlation with scheduled drains?
Maya: Yeah — looks like a zipper-style rolling upgrade. Drains staggered per rack so scheduler keeps reshuffling. Tiny pods get bounced.
SchedulerBot: alert: 23 preemptions in ap-southeast1 in the last 5m. median latency +120ms. https://internal/alerts/1739
Lisa: Warmpool change or autoscaler event?
Maya: Both. Warmpool cooldown + autoscaler removed a couple of spot nodes when conntrack spiked. Result: fragmented free GPUs scattered across racks (pool entropy).
John: So scheduler sees enough resources overall but not contiguous per topologyAffinity -> evicts to satisfy placement.
Arjun: Can you paste a short scheduler snippet?
Maya: ```
I0212 12:34:56.789 kube-scheduler Evicting pod gpu-train-12 - insufficient contiguous slots
I0212 12:34:57.001 kube-scheduler Found 4 free gpus but across 3 racks; respecting topologyAffinity
```
Lisa: That explains it. Topology-aware binpacking refusing cross-rack placement for these workloads.
Arjun: Short-term options: relax topologyAffinity for non-prod/best-effort, or widen backfill window so packer can coalesce.
Maya: Proposal: set scheduler flag `allowCrossRackPacking: true` for staging/nondurable namespaces and bump warmpool target in ap-southeast1 by +2 nodes. Also run an on-demand compaction job to consolidate small free GPUs.
John: +1. And change drain controller to avoid zippering: do per-az batch drains (e.g., 5 nodes at a time) rather than per-node immediate.
SchedulerBot: runbook snippet: if evictions >20 in 10m -> set warmpool.min +=2, autoscaler.gracePeriod=120s, run `task run compact-gpus --region ap-southeast1`
Lisa: FYI that warmpool bump will have a short-term cost impact; cc capacity-ops.
Maya: Opening a ticket now and scheduling compaction run. Ticket: https://redwood/tickets/INC-4321
Arjun: If you want I can patch the scheduler config and roll to staging first.
Maya: Please do. I'll monitor preempt rate and packer telemetry.
SchedulerBot: update: compaction job started.
Maya: Quick update — preemptions down to ~6 in last 5m after compaction started.
John: Nice. If it creeps back up we revert topology tweak and investigate warmpool/spot behaviour deeper.
SchedulerBot: cleared: preemptions reduced below threshold.
Maya: Closing loop once stable for 30m. Thanks all.
